desc:
👋Welcome to the delivery industry!

📌Experience our immersive truck simulator, where you can explore a vast, dynamic world ranging from busy highways to peaceful country roads.
Our game features highly realistic maps and advanced tractor units designed to make every journey engaging.

💬Join our Roblox community and communication server for helpful tips, creative ideas, and exclusive previews of upcoming features.

🛠 Changelog 10/25/26

⭐Group & friend bonuses

🌽Grain delivery bonus 

🎃Halloween event, talk to Jack at the farm for his quest.

🍂Fall map, leaves are falling (can toggle leaf falling effects in settings under weather effects)

⚙️New handling and chassis

🚚Dump trucks & new load types

📈New trailer guide on the map

🔎Better GPS & better shifting

💰HUD size slider, auto blinker setting, & free cam (shift+p)

🚨Many bug fixes and improvements

👍Like If you enjoy the game and favorite! ⭐

⚠️ Caution: This game is updated frequently. ⚠️

V2.1.2
